host_threads.policy: Pin OMP/MKL to six allocated CPUs for this repeated timing run.
host_threads.comparison_scope: Keep prior unpinned 1k smoke diagnostic; use consistently pinned threads for repeated cost curves.
host_threads.causal_claim: This operational pin is not established as a fix for previous startup slowness.

stability.summary: R-KV repetitions remain tightly grouped; StreamingLLM first-use and AgentKV 50/25 percent variation remain. All three points contribute to medians/ranges; no confidence interval or steady-performance claim is inferred.

semantics.ordinary_tps: Synchronized native loop rates include eviction/output processing; scheduling/reset/verification outside the loop remain excluded.
semantics.selection_compaction: Whole instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay totals, nested in inference; not per-token rates or costs to add again.
semantics.warmup: Unchanged source 312 standard synthetic warmup; no additional per-shape warmup. First repetition is not guaranteed cold because preceding work and persistent caches can prime execution.
semantics.memory: Prefill occupancy uses 16384 logical cached tokens; decode occupancy uses 16448. Prefill and ordinary-decode peaks have explicit separate boundaries; reserved pool and total VRAM are distinct.
semantics.comparability: This 64-decode/three-repeat version is separate from 8-decode feasibility and old unpinned 1k smoke.

interpretation: All 30 cells and 90 passes completed under the original cap and time bounds. All ordinary/instrumented pairs match outputs and retention events.
R-KV decode medians at 80/50/25 percent are approximately 1.531/1.571/3.610 tokens per second, with less than 0.25 percent maximum-to-minimum spread across repetitions.
StreamingLLM first-use differences persist. AgentKV 50/25 percent repetitions span about 1.96/2.78 percent. These ranges remain visible and are not removed as outliers.

Maximum total VRAM is 27.786 GiB, above the 12k maximum of 24.814 GiB but below 4k and 8k maxima. Allocator reservation is non-monotone under the pinned runtime; no causal allocator mechanism is established.
Selection and compaction are totals over the entire instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay, not per-token rates or extra costs to add again.
This is one forced historical token sequence and technical repetitions, not model accuracy, task success, recovery quality or task-bootstrap uncertainty.

allocator_reservation_observation.per_pass_reset: Pinned native.start empties allocator cache and resets peak counters on each pass; the high reservation is not simply leftover cache from the preceding method.
allocator_reservation_observation.interpretation: 16k R-KV 80 percent reaches 27.786 GiB total, 27.439 GiB reserved and 24.938 GiB allocated. Whole-workload peaks remain non-monotone across the measured lengths. The 4.50014 GiB reserved KV pool is distinct.

variation_audit.scope: Saved ordinary and instrumented timing boundaries; no rerun or causal attribution.
